stories.title: India Inc earnings growth hits 12-quarter high
stories.summary: Listed companies reported a 30.4 percent year-on-year rise in combined adjusted net profit, the fastest growth in 12 quarters. Net sales grew 22.4 percent, marking the highest increase in 16 quarters. Oil, gas, metals, and power sectors led the gains while FMCG and IT lagged behind.

stories.title: India leads APAC in workplace AI adoption
stories.summary: As many as 96 percent of Indian employees use AI regularly, the highest rate among nine Asia-Pacific markets. According to BCG, these workers save an average of 15 hours a week using the technology, compared to the regional average of 9.4 hours.

stories.title: IKEA India targets profitability by 2029
stories.summary: IKEA India reported revenue of 2,100 crore rupees for the year ending August 2026, a 14 percent increase. While furniture remains the primary revenue driver, food sales now account for 10 percent of business. The company plans to operate 30 stores in the country by 2030.

stories.title: Pharma GCCs in India generate 10.5 billion dollars
stories.summary: India hosts global capability centres for 80 percent of the world's top 20 biopharma companies. These centres now employ 120,000 professionals and generate 10.5 billion dollars in gross value added. The facilities are increasingly handling sophisticated scientific and business functions rather than just support tasks.

stories.title: Private sector project announcements surge in H1
stories.summary: Private sector project announcements rose 58.5 percent to 26.6 lakh crore rupees in the first half of FY27. The sector accounted for 86.2 percent of all project announcements, a figure the Confederation of Indian Industry attributes to sustained government reforms and improving business confidence.

stories.title: Unincorporated sector sees record growth in self-employment
stories.summary: India's unincorporated non-farm economy grew at its fastest quarterly pace on record during July-September. The number of establishments rose 18.81 percent, though the expansion was driven primarily by owner-operated businesses. Growth in hired employment remained relatively weak despite the overall increase in total jobs.

stories.title: Rural economic confidence weakens as fiscal support drops
stories.summary: The RBI Future Expectations Index for villages fell to 112.8 in September from 129.3 in January. More than half of respondents expect the economic outlook to worsen or remain stagnant. This decline in sentiment coincides with a reduction in fiscal support provided to local gram panchayats.

stories.title: Fairfax buyout of IDBI lifts India's PE and VC $8.7bn - NewsBytes
Large deal activity jumps in October
stories.summary: October 2026 saw eight large deals worth 7.3 billion dollars, a 97 percent increase from the same month last year. Fairfax's 5.3 billion dollar acquisition of a 61 percent stake in IDBI Bank accounted for the bulk of the activity. Overall PE and VC investments rose 62 percent.

stories.title: Mega deals reach three-year high
stories.summary: Mega deals exceeding 100 million dollars reached 31.3 billion dollars in the first ten months of 2026. While the total value has surpassed the annual range of the previous three years, the actual number of such deals fell to a three-year low of 74.

stories.title: Sanofi acquisition highlights patent cliff costs
stories.summary: Sanofi's 41 billion dollar purchase of Insmed reflects the high cost of replacing drugs losing patent protection. Bloomberg Intelligence estimates that 675 billion dollars in annual sales are at risk by 2035. The acquisition price is nearly five times the estimated peak sales for the target's therapies.

stories.title: Sanofi agrees to acquire Insmed in biggest pharma deal since 2023 - upi
Shalimar Paints to merge with Infra Market
stories.summary: India's oldest paint company, founded in 1902, is set to merge with its promoter Infra Market. The transaction values the combined entity at approximately 2.1 billion euros. The deal aims to transition the manufacturer into a diversified building-materials platform with new institutional investors.

stories.title: Shadowfax acquires WeFast for 23 crore rupees
stories.summary: Shadowfax Technologies is entering the intra-city logistics market by acquiring WeFast for 23.3 crore rupees. The deal provides access to the target's technology platform, intellectual property, and the Borzo trademark in India. The company aims to compete in a market still dominated by unorganized operators.

stories.title: RBI approves SBI Mutual Fund stake in South Indian Bank
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has approved SBI Mutual Fund's proposal to acquire up to 9.99 percent of South Indian Bank. The approval is subject to specific regulatory conditions. The lender's stock has risen 612 percent over the last five years.

stories.title: RMC Switchgears receives 522 crore rupee project
stories.summary: RMC Switchgears has received a letter of intent for a distribution infrastructure project in Maharashtra valued at 522 crore rupees. The project, which involves constructing new substations and power lines, is worth three times the company's current market capitalisation.

stories.title: IDBI Bank divestment faces legal and union hurdles
stories.summary: IDBI Bank shares remain in focus following a Supreme Court ruling that the lender is not a state-owned bank. This follows the October 2026 divestment deal with Fairfax Financial Holdings. The ruling is the second major setback for the bank's officers' association regarding the ownership transition.

stories.title: Bank unions call strike over IDBI stake sale
stories.summary: Three major bank unions have called for a nationwide strike on December 3 to protest the sale of a 60 percent stake in IDBI Bank to Fairfax Financial Holdings. The unions argue that transferring control to a foreign private entity is not in the national interest.

stories.title: Government to sell stake in IIFCL via IPO
stories.summary: The government plans to sell a portion of its equity in India Infrastructure Finance Company Ltd through an initial public offering alongside a fresh issue of shares. The company has sanctioned over 3.64 trillion rupees for 890 projects. The draft filing is currently in progress.

stories.title: SEBI discourages use of grey market premiums
stories.summary: Market regulator SEBI has instructed intermediaries to stop publishing grey market premium figures for upcoming IPOs. The regulator cautioned investors that these unofficial trading prices are not reliable indicators of potential listing gains. The grey market operates outside of formal stock exchange oversight.

stories.title: Two mainboard IPOs set to open this week
stories.summary: Foodlink F&B Holdings and Integris Medtech are launching IPOs on November 26 and November 27. These follow the recent subscription closures for Mahanadi Coalfields and Crystal Crop Protection. Investors are currently waiting for allotment and listing details for the latter two offerings.

stories.title: Wall Street rally cools as tech stocks retreat
stories.summary: Technology shares declined on November 24, ending a brief market recovery. The Nasdaq Composite fell 2.24 percent and the S&P 500 dropped 0.99 percent, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 0.24 percent. Investors are questioning the sustainability of the recent rebound in semiconductor stocks.

stories.title: Nvidia shares fall after brief rally
stories.summary: Nvidia shares dropped 9 percent on November 24 to 150.50 dollars, reversing part of Monday's 31.48 percent surge. The stock had rallied following the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as CEO. Investors are now reassessing the company's outlook amid concerns regarding AI investment returns and borrowing costs.

stories.title: Nvidia, Anthropic and other AI stocks get back to tumbling and drag the US market lower - WAVY.com
Nvidia gives back gains as market momentum shifts
stories.summary: Nvidia shares fell 5.86 percent on November 24, closing at 155.38 dollars. The decline followed a 31.48 percent surge on Monday, which marked the company's largest single-day gain in over two decades. The reversal suggests that investor enthusiasm for the recent semiconductor rally is fading.

stories.title: Tech selloff halts US market rebound
stories.summary: US markets declined on November 24 as technology stocks retreated. The Nasdaq 100 fell 1.5 percent and the S&P 500 lost 1.3 percent. Nvidia dropped 4.7 percent following reports of internal concerns at AI firms regarding model power. Asian markets showed a different trend, with the Kospi rising.

stories.title: Nvidia shares surge following leadership change
stories.summary: Nvidia shares rose 31 percent on Monday after the company reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO. The move followed pressure from US President Donald Trump and helped reverse a global equity market rout. The rally boosted technology stocks, with the Nasdaq 100 rising 6.5 percent.

stories.title: Wall Street Cuts Nvidia Price Targets By 25% Despite Latest Reversal - BeInCrypto
RBI proposes new digital payment safeguards
stories.summary: The RBI has proposed a stop switch facility to block debits and a trusted person authentication mechanism to combat banking fraud. The regulator also suggested expanding the definition of bank negligence to include failures in reporting channels and mandatory transaction alerts. The central bank is seeking increased consumer protection.

stories.title: US Justice Department reports 800 fraud arrests
stories.summary: The US Department of Justice announced the arrest of over 800 individuals linked to criminal fraud networks. Operation Blackout involved raids on call centers across 10 countries and resulted in the seizure of nearly 17 billion dollars in illicit funds. Predatory schemes remain a stated focus for authorities.

stories.title: RBI urges NBFCs to improve cybersecurity
stories.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra has called on non-banking financial companies to strengthen cybersecurity infrastructure and prioritize customer protection. The regulator emphasized the need for responsible credit growth and fair recovery practices. NBFCs were also encouraged to utilize the Central KYC Records Registry for customer onboarding.

stories.title: RBI Guidelines On Cyber Resilience 2026: A Security Roadmap For Non-Bank Payment Operators - Security Boulevard
RBI listing rules for large NBFCs remain in focus
stories.summary: The RBI requires non-banking financial companies with assets exceeding 1 trillion rupees to list within three years of being identified as an upper layer entity. The regulator has established these transparency standards to ensure large financial institutions meet public-company requirements without necessarily relying on a listing premium.

stories.title: Pension and insurance funds shift toward equities
stories.summary: Demand for long-term government securities has declined as insurance and pension funds increase their exposure to equities. RBI Deputy Governor Jain noted that this structural shift has impacted the stability of the sovereign debt market. The central bank continues to monitor these changes in institutional investment patterns.

stories.title: SBI report advises against aggressive rate hike
stories.summary: A report from the State Bank of India suggests the RBI should limit its December policy rate increase to 25 basis points. The bank warned that a 50-basis-point hike could trigger capital outflows and currency instability. The central bank is tasked with balancing inflation management against economic growth.

stories.title: Government confirms UPI will remain free
stories.summary: The Finance Ministry stated that UPI will continue to be free for consumers and person-to-person transactions. Any future merchant discount rate charges would apply only to a limited set of transactions above a specific threshold. The amendment is described as an enabling provision for long-term sustainability.

stories.title: Paytm and ChargeZone enable QR payments for EV charging
stories.summary: Paytm has partnered with ChargeZone to enable QR-based payments across 15,000 high-speed EV charging points in India. The system covers 1,200 locations, including highways and commercial hubs. Users scan a code at the station, enter an amount, and complete the transaction through the Paytm app.

stories.title: EPFO tests BHIM UPI for provident fund withdrawals
stories.summary: The EPFO is conducting final validation trials for a BHIM UPI interface to facilitate direct provident fund withdrawals. The system aims to allow 7.48 crore subscribers to track balances and withdraw 75 percent of funds. No official launch date has been set for the reform.

stories.title: Trustly raises $60 million for AI-powered financial tools
stories.summary: Swedish payments firm Trustly has raised $60 million to shift its focus from Pay by Bank solutions toward AI-powered financial intelligence. The capital is intended to support new products for merchant risk management and customer acquisition. The round was supported by Nordic Capital.

stories.title: Trustly secures $60 million in shareholder funding
stories.summary: Swedish open banking company Trustly has raised $60 million from existing shareholders to accelerate its AI-powered growth strategy. The funding follows a recent reduction of the company's workforce by 25 percent.

stories.title: Fintech startup Vegapay to raise Rs 38.4 crore
stories.summary: Mumbai-based lending and card management platform Vegapay is raising Rs 38.4 crore in a Series A round led by Prosus. Existing investors Elevation Capital, Vertex Ventures, and Eximius Ventures are also participating. The startup has passed a resolution to issue compulsory convertible preference shares.

stories.title: Rain reports higher spending on physical cards
stories.summary: Business card provider Rain claims physical cards are more effective than virtual ones for driving spend. According to the company, physical card transactions average 2.5 times the value of virtual ones, while total spending per physical cardholder is 3.6 times higher.

stories.title: Sebi warns of fraudsters impersonating intermediaries
stories.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India has cautioned investors against fraudulent schemes operating on WhatsApp and Telegram. Fraudsters are impersonating registered intermediaries to lure users into opening accounts on unauthorised platforms. The regulator advised investors to verify the legitimacy of their trading platforms.

stories.title: Mutual fund redemption tax rules explained
stories.summary: Investors redeeming mutual funds at a profit are subject to tax based on fund category and holding period. The guidance highlights the importance of advance tax deadlines before July and provides a worked example for a Rs 3.5 lakh gain.

stories.title: Consumer commission rules against insurance claim rejection
stories.summary: A Raipur consumer commission has ordered Aditya Birla Sun Life Insurance to pay Rs 1 crore to a nominee following a death claim. The insurer had cited non-disclosure of medical history, but the commission ruled in favour of the policyholder's family.

stories.title: Can a bank demand home loan EMIs if your builder fails to deliver possession? Supreme Court ruling explained | Mint
stories.summary: Homebuyers stuck with unfinished flats could get relief from banks seeking to recover housing loans, particularly when lenders have released money to developers without checking whether construction has progressed as agreed. The Supreme Court has said that courts must examine whether banks followed the terms of their agreements with builders

stories.title: ITAT reviews tax treatment of spousal cash gifts
stories.summary: The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal has ordered a review of a tax demand on Rs 58 lakh deposited by a woman. The taxpayer claimed the funds were gifts from her husband. The tribunal will examine bank records and land sale deeds to verify the source.

stories.title: ITAT rules GST refunds are not always taxable income
stories.summary: The Delhi bench of the ITAT has ruled that GST refunds are not automatically taxable income for businesses. The tribunal deleted a Rs 3.98 lakh addition made by tax authorities, noting that the refund cannot be treated as income if the original tax was not claimed as an expense.

stories.title: SEBI MF Lite framework aims to reduce passive fund costs
stories.summary: The SEBI MF Lite framework, effective since March 2025, simplifies regulations for passive mutual funds and ETFs. By relaxing compliance and documentation requirements, the regulator aims to lower operational costs and encourage new entrants to the market.

stories.title: Government to form telecom advisory group for startups
stories.summary: Communications Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia announced plans for an advisory group to support telecom startups and MSMEs. The panel will facilitate discussions on product testing, market access, and government support to strengthen the domestic technology manufacturing ecosystem.

stories.title: Scindia promotes indigenous telecom innovation
stories.summary: Union Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia stated that India is transitioning from a consumer to a creator of telecom technology. During a conclave in New Delhi, the government highlighted indigenous solutions and encouraged startups to focus on commercialising homegrown tech.

stories.title: New advisory panel to address telecom startup concerns
stories.summary: Communications Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia announced an advisory panel to resolve issues faced by telecom startups and MSMEs. The initiative aims to connect entrepreneurs with industry leaders and ensure government support for the development of indigenous technology.

stories.title: Scindia rallies domestic innovators for telecom growth
stories.summary: Union Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia chaired a conclave to accelerate the commercialisation of homegrown telecom technologies. He stated that India has shifted from a consumer of technology to a creator over the last decade, urging startups and investors to drive further development.

stories.title: NTPC NVVN invites bids for battery storage projects
stories.summary: NTPC Vidyut Vyapar Nigam has invited global bids for 187.5 MW of standalone battery energy storage systems. The projects will be supported by the Viability Gap Funding mechanism to improve commercial viability and expand India's grid-scale storage infrastructure.

stories.title: RBI notes concentration in government bond market
stories.summary: Reserve Bank of India Deputy Governor Rohit Jain says 72 percent of government bond market liquidity is concentrated in just five securities. Jain called for urgent measures to deepen the market and improve diversification. The market remains focused on a small number of instruments despite growing participation.

stories.title: India hits record LPG production as imports face disruption
stories.summary: India produced a record 9.2 million tonnes of LPG between April and October 2026. The increase follows the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, which impacted 90 percent of imports. Daily production rose 24 percent year on year to meet demand from 32.64 crore households.
